resources.title: The water cycle around Mayon
resources.summary: A 45-minute lesson that follows rain from Mayon's slopes to the Yawa River and back to the clouds, with a cup-and-cover demonstration.
resources.subject: Science

competency.text: Describe the water cycle and how it affects the local community

requirements: One printed worksheet per pair (2 pages)
Clear cup, warm water and plastic cover for the demonstration

references.label: DepEd Science 4 Learner’s Material, Quarter 2; local photos of Mayon taken by the author.

version.note: Shortened the worksheet to two pages and added an answer key, after teacher feedback.

history.note: First shared version with a four-page worksheet.

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners describe evaporation, condensation and precipitation using places they know around Mayon.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Clear cup with warm water
Plastic cover and an ice cube
Printed pair worksheet
Chalkboard sketch of Mayon, the Yawa River and Albay Gulf

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Ask: where does the rain on the school roof go afterwards? (5 min)
Cup demonstration: cover warm water, put ice on top and watch droplets form (10 min)
Trace the cycle on the board sketch: river to sky, clouds over Mayon, rain on the slopes (15 min)
Pairs label the worksheet diagram with the three stages (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Exit question: name one place in our barangay where you saw evaporation this week (5 min)

resources.title: The water cycle around Mayon, Bikol vocabulary version
resources.summary: Ma'am Lira's water cycle lesson with a Bikol–English word bank and a picture-matching warm-up for learners still building English vocabulary.
resources.subject: Science

competency.text: Describe the water cycle and how it affects the local community

requirements: One printed word bank per pair (1 page)
Clear cup, warm water and plastic cover for the demonstration

references.label: Adapted from “The water cycle around Mayon” version 2.0 by Ma'am Lira Bañares.

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

resources.changeNote: Added a Bikol–English word bank and a picture-matching warm-up. Removed the pair worksheet to save printing.

lesson.objective: Learners describe evaporation, condensation and precipitation, first in Bikol and then in English.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Clear cup with warm water
Plastic cover and an ice cube
Printed Bikol–English word bank
Picture cards: sun, cloud, rain, river

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Warm-up: match picture cards to Bikol words, then to English words (10 min)
Cup demonstration from the original lesson (10 min)
Trace the cycle on the board sketch, naming each stage in both languages (15 min)
Pairs explain one stage to each other using the word bank (5 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Exit question: name one stage of the water cycle in Bikol and in English (5 min)

resources.title: States of matter in the kitchen
resources.summary: Learners sort kitchen items into solid, liquid and gas, then watch ice and steam change state using a kettle.
resources.subject: Science

competency.text: Classify materials as solid, liquid or gas

requirements: Activity cards, one set per group (can be handwritten)
Kettle or thermos of hot water, handled by the teacher

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners classify common kitchen materials as solid, liquid or gas and describe one change of state.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Activity cards: rice, cooking oil, salt, steam, vinegar, ice
Kettle or thermos (teacher only)
Three sorting areas on the board

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Groups sort the cards into solid, liquid and gas (10 min)
Teacher shows ice melting and steam rising (10 min)
Groups explain one card they argued about (15 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Each learner writes one solid, one liquid and one gas found at home

resources.title: Percent at the palengke
resources.summary: Learners compute discounts and mark-ups from a mock market stall, using prices written on the board.
resources.subject: Mathematics

competency.text: Solve problems involving percent, discount and mark-up

requirements: Price list written on the board

references.label: Prices collected at Sorsogon public market, September 2026.

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners compute a 10%, 20% and 25% discount and explain which stall offers the better price.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Board price list: fish, rice, pili nuts, abaca bag
One-page worksheet
Optional printed price flashcards

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Review: 10% of 250 by moving the decimal point (5 min)
Two stalls, two discounts: which is cheaper? (15 min)
Pairs solve three mark-up problems from the worksheet (15 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Exit slip: compute the sale price of a ₱180 item at 25% off

resources.title: Reading typhoon signals
resources.summary: Learners connect wind signal numbers to what families in a coastal barangay should prepare, using a printed signal chart.
resources.subject: Science

competency.text: Explain weather warnings and the safety measures they call for

requirements: One printed signal chart per group

references.label: PAGASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal guide. Check the current definitions before teaching.

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners match each wind signal level to a family preparation step.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Printed signal chart (groups)
Go-bag picture cards
Optional poster template

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Share: what did your family do during the last typhoon? (10 min)
Groups match signal levels to preparation cards (15 min)
Groups present one level and its steps (15 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Learners list three go-bag items and when the family should pack them

resources.title: Retelling a short Bicol-inspired story
resources.summary: Learners read a team-written short story about a fisher's daughter in Catanduanes and retell it in order using picture cues.
resources.subject: English

competency.text: Retell a story in sequence using beginning, middle and end

requirements: One story sheet per learner (1 page)
Four picture cue cards (can be drawn on the board)

references.label: Original story by the author, inspired by Bicol tales about Mt. Isarog.

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners retell the story in the right order using first, next, then and finally.

sections.heading: Materials
items: One-page story sheet
Four picture cue cards

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Read the story aloud, then together (10 min)
Order the picture cards on the board (10 min)
Pairs retell the story using the four sequence words (15 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Each learner draws and labels the story's ending

resources.title: Fractions with bibingka slices
resources.summary: Paper bibingka circles help learners compare halves, thirds and fourths before writing them as fractions.
resources.subject: Mathematics

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners fold paper circles into halves, thirds and fourths and order the unit fractions by size.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Three paper circles per learner
Worksheet
Crayons

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Fold one circle into halves and name each part (10 min)
Fold thirds and fourths; compare the slices (15 min)
Order 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 on the worksheet (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Which slice is bigger, 1/3 or 1/4? Learners explain using their circles

resources.title: Mapping our barangay’s hazard zones
resources.summary: Learners draw a simple map of the barangay and mark flood, landslide and evacuation areas using symbols and a legend.
resources.subject: Araling Panlipunan

competency.text: Identify hazards in the community and ways to prepare for them

requirements: Manila paper and crayons per group

files.name: hazard-map-template.docx
files.label: Printable map template and symbol legend

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners mark at least three hazard areas and the nearest evacuation center on a barangay map with a legend.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Manila paper, crayons and a ruler per group
Printed symbol legend (supplement)
Photo of the barangay hall map, if available

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Talk: where did water reach during the last typhoon? (5 min)
Show map symbols and build a class legend (10 min)
Groups draw the route from school to the evacuation center (20 min)
Gallery walk and peer check with the rubric (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Each group explains one hazard and one way to prepare for it

resources.title: Writing a friendly letter to a pen pal
resources.summary: Learners write a five-part friendly letter to a pen pal from another Bicol province, using a model letter about fiesta preparations.
resources.subject: English

competency.text: Write a friendly letter observing the correct format

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners write a friendly letter with heading, greeting, body, closing and signature.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Model letter (printed, one per pair)
Lined paper

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Read the model letter aloud and label its five parts (10 min)
Brainstorm what to tell a pen pal about our fiesta (10 min)
Write the first draft (20 min)
Swap with a partner and check against the checklist (5 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Submit a letter that includes all five parts

resources.title: Sorting by color and size with market finds
resources.summary: Hands-on sorting with things from the palengke: calamansi, sili, pili nuts and bottle caps. Learners sort by color, then by size.
resources.subject: Kindergarten

competency.text: Sort and classify objects according to one attribute

requirements: A small basket of real objects per group

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners sort a set of objects by color and then by size, and explain their groups.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Basket of calamansi, sili, pili nuts and bottle caps
Two paper plates per group
Picture cards for learners who are absent from the basket station

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Song: “Kulay, kulay” warm-up (5 min)
Teacher models sorting by color (5 min)
Groups sort by color, then mix and sort by size (15 min)
Each group shows one plate and says why the things belong together (5 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Observation checklist: sorts correctly by one attribute

resources.title: Reading short-a words with local foods
resources.summary: Phonics lesson for short a (CVC) words, using pictures of local foods and a pocket-chart game. Includes a Bikol word list for the warm-up.
resources.subject: English

competency.text: Read words with short a in CVC pattern

requirements: Pocket chart or a string line with clips

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners read and match eight short-a words to pictures.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Flashcards: can, pan, bag, hat, mat, fan, jam, cap
Pocket chart

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Warm-up with Bikol words for the pictures (5 min)
Model blending c-a-n (10 min)
Pocket-chart matching game in pairs (15 min)
Read the words together as a class (5 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Each learner reads four words from the flashcards

resources.title: Simple machines on the farm
resources.summary: Learners find levers, pulleys and inclined planes in farm tools from their own homes, then test a lever with a ruler and coins.
resources.subject: Science

competency.text: Describe how simple machines make work easier

requirements: Ruler, pencil and ten coins per group

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners identify three simple machines used on farms and show how moving the fulcrum changes the effort needed.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Ruler, pencil and ten one-peso coins per group
Pictures of a kariton, pulley well and bolo

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Show farm tool pictures: which ones help us lift or move? (10 min)
Lever experiment: move the fulcrum and count coins (20 min)
Record results in the table (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Exit slip: name one simple machine at home and what it helps with

resources.title: Volcanoes of Bicol: Mayon and Bulusan
resources.summary: Compares an active stratovolcano and its hazards using PHIVOLCS alert levels, a clay cross-section model and a hazard-map reading activity.
resources.subject: Science

competency.text: Describe the different types of volcanoes and volcanic eruptions

requirements: Modeling clay or a paper cross-section

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners explain how Mayon and Bulusan erupt and what each PHIVOLCS alert level asks residents to do.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Modeling clay in three colors, or the paper cross-section
Printed alert level table

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Recall: who has seen Mayon’s lava at night? (5 min)
Build the cross-section and label the parts (20 min)
Read the alert level table and match actions to levels (15 min)
Discussion: what should our school do at Alert Level 3? (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Short quiz on volcano parts and alert levels

resources.title: Linear equations with jeepney fares
resources.summary: Learners model jeepney fares (minimum fare plus a rate per kilometer) as linear equations, graph them, and compare routes.
resources.subject: Mathematics

competency.text: Write and graph linear equations from real situations

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners write y = mx + b for two jeepney routes and use their graphs to find which is cheaper for a given distance.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Fare matrix from the local terminal (sample included)
Graphing paper and rulers

sections.heading: Procedure
items: How much is your fare to school? Build a class table (10 min)
Find the minimum fare and rate per kilometer (10 min)
Write and graph the equations in pairs (20 min)
Compare two routes and present (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Three word problems on the worksheet

resources.title: Ang Epikong Ibalong: Pagsusuri ng tauhan
resources.summary: Pagbasa at pagsusuri sa mga tauhan ng Ibalong (Baltog, Handyong, Bantong) gamit ang graphic organizer at talakayang pangkatan.
resources.subject: Filipino

competency.text: Nasusuri ang mga katangian ng tauhan sa epiko

files.name: ibalong-question-cards.docx
files.label: Mga kard ng tanong para sa talakayan

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Nasusuri ng mga mag-aaral ang katangian at kabayanihan ng tatlong pangunahing tauhan ng Ibalong.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Buod ng Ibalong (2 pahina)
Graphic organizer

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Pagganyak: Sino ang bayani sa inyong barangay? (5 min)
Pangkatang pagbasa ng buod (15 min)
Pagpuno ng graphic organizer bawat tauhan (15 min)
Pag-uulat ng bawat pangkat (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Maikling sanaysay: Aling tauhan ang pinakahahangaan mo at bakit?

resources.title: Plate boundaries of the Philippines
resources.summary: Inquiry lesson on convergent, divergent and transform boundaries using the Philippine Trench, Philippine Fault and a paper-slide model.
resources.subject: Earth and Life Science

competency.text: Describe the different types of plate boundaries

permission.notice: Shared by the author under the license shown.

lesson.objective: Learners classify three Philippine geologic features by plate boundary type and explain the motion involved.

sections.heading: Materials
items: Printed map of the Philippine Fault and Trench
Two sheets of paper per pair for the slide model

sections.heading: Procedure
items: Recall recent earthquakes in Bicol (5 min)
Paper-slide model for each boundary type (15 min)
Map reading: label features on the Philippine map (15 min)
Synthesis: why is Bicol earthquake-prone? (10 min)

sections.heading: Assessment
items: Worksheet questions 1–6

seedReviews.text: The cup demonstration worked even without a projector. My Grade 4 class in Iriga got it in one period.
Two pages is so much easier to print than the old worksheet. I added a short Bikol word list for my slower readers.
Version 1.0 had a four-page worksheet. Too much to print for 45 learners.
Good sorting game and the kids loved it. The steam part needs a clearer safety note before you boil water.
Learners liked using real pili nut and bangus prices. I changed the stalls to our own market in Iriga.
Timely before typhoon season. We used it the week Signal No. 2 was raised.
Folding the paper bibingka worked better than cutting. Less mess, same idea.
Ran this right after the flood drill. The legend template saved me a whole evening.
Our Grade 4 maps went on the wall of the DRRM office.
Good lesson. I needed an extra period for the gallery walk.
Simple and clear. I paired my class with a section in Catanduanes and they actually wrote back.
The fiesta model letter is perfect for our learners.
My kinders sorted for 20 minutes without getting bored. Real calamansi is the trick.
Easy to set up with what we already have.
I used buttons instead of sili for safety.
The Bikol warm-up really helps my non-readers start.
Flashcards print well even in black and white.
The coin lever experiment is simple and the results are clear.
I added a tricycle example since many parents drive one.
Best volcano lesson I have used. The alert level table is exactly what my Albay learners need.
The 20-item quiz in the bundle is worth it. Answer key is accurate.
Clay model is messy but memorable. Paper version works for big classes.
Used it for our Grade 9 demo teaching. Observers liked the local context.
Finally, a linear equations lesson my learners care about.
Update the fare matrix to your own terminal before class.
The graph comparison at the end sparked a good debate.
Napakaganda ng graphic organizer. Madaling sundan ng mga bata.
Sulit ang question cards para sa pangkatang talakayan.
Paper-slide model is a great low-cost demo for STEM 11.
Tied in well with the earthquake drill.
